Faster queues and a more responsive interface for long transcription jobs.

## Highlights

- Enables Metal acceleration by default for the bundled Whisper runtime.
- Processes eligible queued files concurrently and recalculates the execution plan as each file finishes.
- Uses current CPU load and available memory when selecting worker count and threads per file.
- Buffers engine output and updates the interface at a controlled rate, reducing UI work during verbose runs.
- Adds the Transcriber app icon and clearer macOS installation guidance.

## Install

Download **Transcriber-1.1.0-macOS-arm64.zip**, unzip it, and move `Transcriber.app` to Applications.

**Requirements:** Apple Silicon and macOS 13.3 or newer.

If macOS blocks the first launch, Control-click `Transcriber.app`, choose **Open**, then confirm **Open**.

[Compare changes from v1.0.0](https://github.com/Pluze/transcriber/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0)
